policy.record_selection: Resolve the accepted record only through the current pointer.
policy.quantitative_source: Quantitative panels must be rendered from record-local maintained-derived tables or arrays by record-frozen Python source code.
policy.master_composite: The accepted master SVG, PDF, PNG, or TIFF is validation authority only and is never a quantitative renderer input.
policy.fixed_asset_policy: Only an explicitly listed illustrative schematic or field-of-view image may be fixed.
